title: A table constructor mixing an integer and a decimal number converts the column to one numeric type

source.quote: When the data types of the values for a column are different in different rows, all values are converted to a common data type.
When a decimal is involved, the result is decimal.
source.supports: between an integer and a decimal number the wider type is the decimal number

derivation: The values are an integer and a decimal number (double). The common type that holds both is double, so the column is double: 1.0 and 2.5.
alternative: The page does not name the common type for numbers. If the engine does not unify them the column would be variant, holding the int64 1 and the double 2.5.
